I do two things that are a bit different from your typical shower.

First I fill the tub ankle-high with the coldest water I can get (obviously this only works with a bathtub/shower situation). Then I shower with nice hot water while my feet remain very cold.

Then I unplug the drain and turn the shower down fairly cold. Going from hot to cold is sometimes called a "Scottish shower". It's quite invigorating.

The reason for the first part is that the top of my feet are very susceptible to rashes (a combination of sensitive skin and a high instep). I like to start my shower with nice hot water, but this inflames my rashes. The cold water is to protect my feet. The sensation of having most of my body hot and my feet cold was weird at first, but I've come to enjoy it.

I'll attempt the same routine when I shower with my boyfriend, but it's hard because I like to get everything done as fast as I can so I don't run out of hot water. Because I like hot water. I also prefer taking my shower at night because I have thick long hair that takes forever to dry (I don't like blow drying it because it makes my hair all frizzy) and if I shower in the morning I'd have to get up at 3AM in order to have it dry by the time I went into work. I will take a shower in the morning if I don't go to work that day. I also like taking night showers because after work I usually go to the gym so I'm all sweaty and smelly from not only work, but the gym as well.
